arChildNodes.szComment:
Menu-Line: "This has something to do with me, doesn't it?"

Giving bad news. The Vault is turning against the Player, because of Lilith's blood inside them.
Frustrated with himself. Tyrael has lost a great deal of his memory of his time as an angel, and he thinks he must have known about this once. This is a source of shame.
Tyrael assesses the damage: his foible has cost them valuable time. Using that frustration as fuel.

Jered Cain: jerr-ed kayn
Iben Fahd: ih-behn faad

Zoltun Kulle:  ZOL-tan KULL
Tal Rasha: tawl rosh-uh

Tyrael agrees with Lorath. No guesswork required.
This situation is embarassing. He wants to resolve it quickly.
